# Composite steps: a phrase calls a phrase and changes one field of a record
<!-- GENERATED from the Phrase Board (issue #148, sha256:0875cd643a7efd38b33bb7abd07265b6cb00dac83e66d57a5f84720ab984472d). Do not edit this file: edit the issue. -->


- **Status:** Ready
- **Shape:** Story
- **Type:** feature (thin slice)
- **Milestone:** Usable v1 (shortest path to a real prototype)
- **Source:** Review of card 135 (Decider D98, 2026-10-28): the Tasks demo app meets the card in structure (five endpoints, eleven specs, zero warnings, all specs pass) but every piece of behaviour sits in five native csharp blocks and the list endpoint carries a fake available input only to have a failure spec. These thin cards close the real gaps so the prototype shows Phrase expressing logic. They sit after the Usable v1 acceptance (138) and before the ZOMBIES card (134).
- **Depends on:** 145
- **Story:** As Ari, I want a phrase to call other phrases and to build a record with one field changed, so that complete task reads as steps instead of native code.
- **Acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then; at most 3, each failing on partial work):**
  1. Given a composite phrase complete task, When it is written with steps that find the task, make a copy with done set to true and save it, Then its specs pass (a known id completes, an unknown id is NotFound) and it contains no native block
  2. Given the failure union, When the composite calls phrases that can fail, Then it surfaces the union of their declared failures (the composite rule of card 045) and a spec with a failing leaf passes
  3. Given the language, When the record copy form is added, Then it is a documented language decision (a Decider) and the Tasks app uses it in complete task

## Context

- Closes the composite-steps finding of the card 135 review. Composites cannot return a value in v0.1 (PH325): the decision must say how a composite hands a record to respond with.
